title: AMD action: getpatientvisits
description: List all visits for one specific patient (history). Returns patient_id, count, by_provider, by_facility, by_apptstatus, and by_year. The per-row fields (visit_id, starttime, duration, apptstatus, provider_id, provider_name, facility_id, facility_name, profile, reason, patient_name, chart_number) feed the summaries; the surfaced response is the aggregated envelope, not the raw rows.
